title: ML Weft
description:
ML Weft is an open research program from Moissanite Labs on adaptive models that change themselves within bounds that a program can check. This archive is the source repository: the runtime (Plasm cells, invariants, the interaction-combinator VM and BCP codec, telemetry, the ledger simulator and gateway, Aywa), its tests, the design documents, and the sources and editions of the ML Weft papers.

Source code is licensed under Apache-2.0. Documentation and the papers are licensed under CC BY 4.0; see NOTICE in the archive. The exported widgets in site/widgets/ load third-party modules and fonts from Google hosts at runtime; those resources are not part of this archive.

Status: early research. Weft has no coin or token and nothing deployed to any blockchain.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
